events.label: Наука
entries: 1811 – The silver deposits of Agua Amarga are discovered in Chile becoming in the following years instrumental for the Patriots to finance the Chilean War of Independence.
1956 – The first commercial nuclear power station is officially opened by Queen Elizabeth II in Sellafield, England.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1771 – Premiere in Milan of the opera Ascanio in Alba, composed by Mozart at age 15.
1969 – The Caravaggio painting Nativity with St. Francis and St. Lawrence is stolen from the Oratory of Saint Lawrence in Palermo.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1456 – The University of Greifswald is established as the second oldest university in northern Europe.
1558 – Poczta Polska, the Polish postal service, is founded.
1919 – Leeds United F.C. founded at Salem Chapel, Holbeck after the winding up of Leeds City F.C. for making illegal payments to players during World War I
2018 – A mass shooting and bombing at Kerch Polytechnic College in Crimea kills 21 people including the attacker and injures 70 others.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1975 – 'Salem's Lot, an American vampire novel by Stephen King, is published.
1994 – Russian journalist Dmitry Kholodov is assassinated while investigating corruption in the armed forces.
